workflows.name: Batch-publish pages from a data tree
workflows.user_goal: Generate one GitBook page per tree branch (per building level, zone, room, component type...) in a single Change Request instead of creating pages one at a time in the GitBook UI
workflows.data_shape: tree of records (one branch per page) -> parallel tree of insert_page change operations

workflows.name: Tabular data to Markdown table page
workflows.user_goal: Turn a rows x columns tree/list (a schedule, a material takeoff, a load-case summary) into a Markdown table inserted or updated into a page
workflows.data_shape: tree/list of rows x columns -> single Markdown table string

workflows.name: Parametric per-item page content
workflows.user_goal: Vary page content (title, description, embedded computed values) across every item in a tree using computed values, e.g. one spec page per structural element type populated from analysis results
workflows.data_shape: tree of computed values -> parallel tree of page document strings

workflows.name: Change-request lifecycle round-trip
workflows.user_goal: Model GitBook's actual (mandatory) write path explicitly: create a Change Request, apply a batch of content changes, optionally request reviewers, then merge -- since there is no direct write to live content
workflows.data_shape: n/a - structural write path every other write workflow ends in

workflows.name: Sync existing docs when the model changes
workflows.user_goal: Re-run a parametric update: find pages by path, regenerate their Markdown from current Grasshopper data, and push update_page operations for only the changed pages in one Change Request
workflows.data_shape: tree of (page path, new content) pairs -> parallel tree of update_page change operations

workflows.name: Insert an image into a GitBook page from any source
workflows.user_goal: Build an image file to embed in a page from whichever source is on hand -- a local file path, a Bitmap object already in the GH session, a URL, or a live capture of the active Rhino 3D viewport -- without needing a different component per source
workflows.data_shape: one of {file path, bitmap, URL, Rhino viewport capture} -> (insert_files operation) + (Image Block JSON)

workflows.name: Rich, styled JSON page content
workflows.user_goal: Author pages primarily through GitBook's structured JSON document model rather than Markdown -- styled inline text (bold, italic, strikethrough, code, keyboard, superscript, subscript, text/background color), plus block-level structure (headings, paragraphs, hint callouts, expandables, cards, tables) -- so richer formatting than Markdown alone is available from Grasshopper
workflows.data_shape: chained Text JSON mark components (recursive, one style per component) -> Block JSON builders -> Blocks JSON aggregate -> Document JSON
